name: North China Pharmaceutical Company Ltd.
summary: North China Pharmaceutical Company Ltd. is a Chinese firm specializing in the chemical pharmaceutical sector. Its extensive product range primarily features anti-infective medications, supplied as active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), their intermediates, and final preparations. The company's offerings further encompass biotechnological therapeutics, drugs for cardiovascular conditions, immunomodulators, vitamin-based consumer health products, and specialized pharmaceuticals for agricultural and veterinary applications. Founded in 1953, North China Pharmaceutical Company Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Shijiazhuang, China.
